text:
Keeping secrets is
Intelligence's cardinal rule.
Until the plan was underway,
I couldn't tell
even you, sister.
So I have no choice...
Letting a setback become your downfall
because you care too much about
appearances would defeat the point.
I'll handle all the dirty work.
All you have to do, sister,
is turn a blind eye.
Understood...
Well then,
shall we make a deal?
...
I just have to
hand this over, right?
I just have to
hand this over, right?
Go on, sister.
You heard the offer.
Go and take it.
...
I'm sorry...
Azlier...
There. Don't ever
let it go again.
...!
Now you should
be satisfied...
Let everyone go!
Now you should
be satisfied...
Please let
everyone go!
Of course.
Here you go!
Teacher!
...
Now you lot
need to get
out of the way too!
...Look out!
Huh...
Eeeeek!?
WHAT ARE YOU DOING...?
One hostage
for one item...
A fair price, wouldn't you say?
Wh...
If you want everyone released,
you'll have to offer
something else in payment.
What more
could you want!?
What more
could you possibly want!?
Let's see...
Your life, perhaps?
!
Ishlar!?
If the wielder dies, we no longer
have to fear this sword's power.
Am I wrong!?
Hehehe. Don't tell me
you're going to object,
Captain?
It's not like
he's your man
or anything, is it?
...!
You can sacrifice yourself
for everyone's sake.
●, I think
that would be a most
fitting end for you.
I think
that would be a most
fitting end for you.
